alibabacloud-rds-copilot v0.0.2

- Enforced required AI-Mode enablement and User-Agent setting before running any CLI commands.
- Updated all CLI command samples to use the specific User-Agent: AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-rds-copilot.
- Clarified plugin auto-installation and updating steps for reliable operation.
- Improved documentation for setup and pre-checks to reduce user errors.
